graeagle.name: Graeagle Cabin
graeagle.tagline: Your mountain escape in the Sierra Nevada
graeagle.parking: Driveway fits 3 cars. Additional street parking available.
checkInInstructions: Drive to the property — look for the pine tree mailbox
Enter the keypad code on the front door
Keys are hanging on the hook inside the entrance
Trash cans are in the side yard — weekly pickup is Tuesday
checkOutInstructions: Strip all bed linens and place in the laundry room
Start a load of dishes if the dishwasher is full
Take trash to the cans outside
Lock all doors and leave the key on the kitchen counter
Check that all windows are closed and locked
houseRules: Max 8 guests — no unauthorized additional guests
No parties or events without prior approval
Respect the neighbors — we're in a residential area

localGuide.name: Graeagle Lumberyard Restaurant
localGuide.note: Local favorite, great burgers, 5 min away

northstar.name: Northstar Luxury Chalet
northstar.parking: Heated garage fits 2 cars. Village parking available nearby.
checkInInstructions: Park in the Northstar Village parking structure if needed
Walk to Chalet Row — look for the blue door on unit 14
Lockbox is on the deck railing (right side)
Enter the code and retrieve the keys
Ski locker code matches the lockbox — great for gear storage
checkOutInstructions: Strip bed linens and leave in the hallway
Run the dishwasher with all dishes loaded
Report any issues to host before leaving
houseRules: No smoking — this is a non-smoking property
Dogs welcome (1 dog, max 50 lbs) — cleaning fee applies
Ski equipment must be stored in the ski locker, not inside
No open flames except in the fireplace
Hot tub: shower before use, max 4 people at once

localGuide.name: Rubicon Pizza
localGuide.note: Best pizza in Northstar Village, walking distance

localGuide.name: Northstar Ski Resort
localGuide.note: Right outside your door — 97 runs, 3 terrain parks

localGuide.name: Lake Tahoe
localGuide.note: 15 min drive, world-class views and beach access
